parameters.reasoning: The paper uses VASP with PBE functional, a 15x15x1 k-grid, 400 eV plane-wave cutoff, and 15 Å vacuum. SIESTA uses NAO basis, so plane-wave cutoff has no equivalent. The paper does not specify NAO basis size, so we assume DZP (standard for PdSe2). For 2D systems, vacuum axis must have exactly 1 division (so kgrid_z=1). The paper states vacuum spacing (15 Å) but SIESTA requires vacuum spacing to be set as a separate parameter (vacuum_spacing_ang). The paper does not specify mesh_cutoff_ry, so we choose 300 Ry (standard for PdSe2). The paper uses PBE functional, so SIESTA uses GGA/PBE. Hybrid/meta-GGA functionals are unsupported in standard SIESTA, but the paper uses PBE so no issue. The paper does not specify smearing, so we use default (0.01 eV) but this is not in the output fields. The paper does not specify spin polarization, so we assume non-spin-polarized (default).
